headline: Kai, the S&P needed exactly one day to erase the post-hike drop, and this morning's futures are adding to it.
subline: Thursday's 1.1 percent rebound, oil settling near $100 as Saudi crude finds a route around its damaged pipeline, and FedEx's report plus August industrial production shaping the open.
asof: Pre-market · as of ~6:50 AM ET · index figures are futures; the 10-year, gold and oil are Thursday's closing marks · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Fed raises rates to 3.75–4.00 percent
items.sentence: Wednesday's quarter-point increase passed 12–0, and the statement says the move 'will support a timelier return' to 2 percent inflation, per the Federal Reserve.

items.title: Thursday's rebound erased the post-hike losses
items.sentence: The S&P 500 rose 1.14 percent to 7,637.72 and the Nasdaq 1.69 percent while the 10-year yield eased to 4.934 percent, per TheStreet.

items.title: Futures point higher into Friday's open
items.sentence: S&P 500 futures are up 0.41 percent early Friday, with Nasdaq 100 futures ahead 0.74 percent and Dow futures up 0.34 percent, per Investing.com.

items.title: Officials pencil in a second hike this year
items.sentence: Bond yields and oil both eased Thursday after the Fed's first increase since 2023, with officials anticipating one more before year-end, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Bitcoin holds above $77,000 after the hike
items.sentence: Bitcoin trades at $77,531.60, up 1.45 percent over the past 24 hours, per The Block.

items.title: Saudi crude reroutes through Hormuz workaround
items.sentence: Riyadh is offering more crude via the strait after the pipeline attack, moving barrels by ship-to-ship transfer off Oman, and oil prices eased, per CNBC.

items.title: UN experts allege war crimes in Iran strikes
items.sentence: A UN panel found reasonable grounds that US strikes killed at least 177 civilians in Iran, per 10 Things' global briefing.

items.title: Russia votes, framed as a war mandate
items.sentence: Russia's parliamentary election is being cast by the Kremlin as proof of public backing for the war in Ukraine, per 10 Things.

items.title: Sweden's centre-left wins a narrow victory
items.sentence: The bloc edged out the governing right, positioning Social Democrat Magdalena Andersson to lead coalition talks, per Euronews.

items.title: Xi's Washington summit penciled in for September 24
items.sentence: Trump floated the date for Xi's visit, per Transport Topics, with researchers on both sides proposing nuclear-style AI safeguards for the agenda.

items.title: Anthropic leases 2.16-gigawatt Queensland data centre
items.sentence: The A$32 billion agreement with Singapore-based developer Zerra DC, near Dalby, is Anthropic's first Australian data-centre deal and will run Claude, per ABC News.

items.title: Crusoe raises $3.9 billion for AI factories
items.sentence: The Series F funds both large campuses and factory-built modular data centers, per TechCrunch.

items.title: House votes 417–3 on data-center power costs
items.sentence: The Ratepayer Protection Act makes data centers pay for the grid upgrades built to serve them, with states free to opt out, per Tech Times.

items.title: Google ships Gemini 3.8 Live voice models
items.sentence: The Live and Extended Thinking models reason while they speak and now sit behind Gemini Live, per Google's announcement.

items.title: Novo Nordisk taps Claude for drug discovery
items.sentence: The Danish drugmaker will use Anthropic's models to speed up drug discovery and development work, per Yahoo Finance.
